summary: Add Expense Management with analytics dashboards using existing TypeScript (Hono) APIs, JSON schemas, and json-render pages, extending current routers/pages/navigation rather than recreating project scaffolding.

features.title: Codebase audit & alignment for Expense module
features.description: Identify existing schemas, routers, pages, UI components, auth/user table naming, and response conventions to ensure the Expense module extends current patterns without duplication.

tasks.title: Inventory existing schema/api/page patterns
tasks.description: Review config/schema/*.json, config/api/*.routes.ts, config/pages/**, and config/apps.json to confirm: (1) timestamp field conventions, (2) primary key type (uuid vs int), (3) how list pagination/search/filter are implemented, (4) how createDataClient is used, (5) auth context fields (e.g., user id available on c.get('user') or similar), and (6) existing shared UI components in src/client/components/ui/ (tables, forms, date pickers, charts). Produce a short checklist used by subsequent tasks to avoid creating duplicates.

subtasks.title: Confirm existing Users table/schema name for foreign keys
subtasks.description: Locate the user schema/table (e.g., users, app_users) and standard field name for id; document for created_by references.

subtasks.title: Confirm component availability for analytics (charts/date range)
subtasks.description: Check ComponentRegistry for chart components and date-range inputs; document recommended components or fallback to tables + metric cards.

features.title: Expense data model + core CRUD APIs
features.description: Create the underlying schemas and Hono APIs for expenses, categories, vendors, and payment accounts with consistent pagination/filtering and safe validation.

tasks.title: Define ExpenseCategory schema
tasks.description: Create (or extend if already present) config/schema/expense_categories.json with fields: id (uuid, primary key), name (text, required), color (text, optional), icon (text, optional), is_active (boolean, default true), sort_order (int, default 0), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Add unique index on name.

subtasks.title: Add indexes and constraints for expense_categories
subtasks.description: Ensure unique(name) and an index on is_active/sort_order if used for UI ordering.

tasks.title: Define Vendor schema
tasks.description: Create (or extend if already present) config/schema/vendors.json with fields: id (uuid, primary key), name (text, required), website (text, optional), notes (text, optional), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Add unique index on name.

subtasks.title: Add search-friendly index for vendor name
subtasks.description: Add index on name to support typeahead/search in expense forms.

tasks.title: Define PaymentAccount schema
tasks.description: Create (or extend if already present) config/schema/payment_accounts.json with fields: id (uuid, primary key), name (text, required), type (text, required; e.g., 'cash'|'credit_card'|'bank'|'other'), last4 (text, optional), is_active (boolean, default true), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Add index on is_active and unique(name).

tasks.title: Define Expense schema
tasks.description: Create config/schema/expenses.json with fields: id (uuid, primary key), expense_date (date or timestamp, required), amount (decimal, required), currency (text, default 'USD'), description (text, optional), category_id (uuid, FK to expense_categories.id, required), vendor_id (uuid, FK to vendors.id, optional), payment_account_id (uuid, FK to payment_accounts.id, optional), reimbursable (boolean, default false), status (text, default 'posted'; values 'draft'|'posted'|'reimbursed'), receipt_url (text, optional), created_by (uuid, required; FK to existing users table discovered in audit), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Add indexes on (created_by, expense_date desc), category_id, vendor_id, status.

subtasks.title: Align field types with existing conventions
subtasks.description: Match decimal/timestamp/date types to existing schema patterns (e.g., numeric precision/scale, ISO timestamps).

tasks.title: Implement ExpenseCategory/Vendor/PaymentAccount CRUD APIs
tasks.description: Add or extend routers in config/api for reference data: GET /api/expense-categories (list; filter is_active), POST /api/expense-categories, PUT /api/expense-categories/:id, DELETE /api/expense-categories/:id (prefer soft delete via is_active=false if that is the project pattern). Repeat for /api/vendors and /api/payment-accounts. Use createDataClient(c.env), validate required fields, enforce unique name with friendly errors, and return consistent { success, data, error } payloads.

subtasks.title: Add list search support for vendors
subtasks.description: Support query params like ?q= to search vendor name; limit results for typeahead use.

tasks.title: Implement Expenses CRUD API with filtering/pagination
tasks.description: Create or extend config/api/expenses.routes.ts with: GET /api/expenses (pagination: page/pageSize or limit/offset; filters: date_from/date_to, category_id, vendor_id, payment_account_id, status, reimbursable; search: q over description/vendor), GET /api/expenses/:id, POST /api/expenses (validate amount>0, required fields, attach created_by from auth context if available), PUT /api/expenses/:id, DELETE /api/expenses/:id. Ensure user scoping by created_by for all reads/writes if the app is multi-user.

subtasks.title: Normalize amount/currency handling
subtasks.description: Ensure amount is stored consistently; if multi-currency is in scope, validate currency format (ISO 4217) and keep analytics grouped by currency.

dependencies: Codebase audit & alignment for Expense module

features.title: Expense management UI (CRUD pages)
features.description: Deliver json-render pages for listing, creating, editing, viewing, and deleting expenses with filters and reference-data management.

tasks.title: Create Expenses List page
tasks.description: Create config/pages/expenses/list.tsx using json-render Renderer with: PageHeader (title 'Expenses', primary action 'Add Expense' → /expenses/new), filter row (date range, category, vendor, status, reimbursable), SearchBar (q), DataTable (columns: expense_date, description, category, vendor, amount, status badge, reimbursable), row actions (view → /expenses/{{id}}, edit → /expenses/{{id}}/edit, delete → delete_confirm calling DELETE /api/expenses/{{id}} then refresh_data). DataSource fetch from GET /api/expenses with bound filters + pagination.

subtasks.title: Wire reference dropdowns to APIs
subtasks.description: Populate category/vendor/payment account dropdown options from their list endpoints; cache via page-level dataSources if supported.

tasks.title: Create Expense Create/Edit pages
tasks.description: Create config/pages/expenses/create.tsx and config/pages/expenses/edit.tsx with a Form: expense_date (date), amount (number), currency (select/text), category_id (select), vendor_id (select with optional), payment_account_id (select optional), reimbursable (switch), status (select), description (textarea), receipt_url (text). Actions: submit_form POST /api/expenses (create) and PUT /api/expenses/:id (edit), on success navigate back to list or detail; include client-side required validation consistent with existing form patterns.

subtasks.title: Prefill edit form from GET /api/expenses/:id
subtasks.description: Bind form initial values from a dataSource; handle loading and not-found states using existing patterns.

tasks.title: Create Expense Detail page
tasks.description: Create config/pages/expenses/detail.tsx showing key fields in Cards (amount, date, category, vendor, status, reimbursable) plus receipt link. Include actions: Edit (navigate), Delete (delete_confirm), Back to list. DataSource: GET /api/expenses/:id.

tasks.title: Create Reference Data management pages (Categories, Vendors, Payment Accounts)
tasks.description: Create config/pages/expense-categories/list.tsx, config/pages/vendors/list.tsx, config/pages/payment-accounts/list.tsx with DataTables + inline actions to add/edit/delete. Use modal form pattern if it exists; otherwise separate create/edit pages. Ensure options used by expenses stay consistent (prefer soft delete is_active=false).

subtasks.title: Add quick-create vendor/category from Expense form (optional, if supported by components)
subtasks.description: If existing UI supports it, add a 'Create new' action beside selects calling POST endpoints then refresh_data and set selected value.

tasks.title: Register Expense module routes & navigation
tasks.description: Update config/apps.json to add routes: /expenses → expenses/list, /expenses/new → expenses/create, /expenses/:id → expenses/detail, /expenses/:id/edit → expenses/edit, /expense-categories → expense-categories/list, /vendors → vendors/list, /payment-accounts → payment-accounts/list. Add navigation group 'Expenses' with links and an appropriate icon per existing conventions; apply permissions if the project uses them (e.g., expenses:read/write).

dependencies: Expense data model + core CRUD APIs

features.title: Expense analytics (dashboard + aggregate APIs)
features.description: Provide analytics endpoints and a dashboard page for spend trends, category breakdowns, and vendor insights with date range filtering.

tasks.title: Implement Expense analytics API endpoints
tasks.description: Create (or extend) config/api/expense-analytics.routes.ts providing: GET /api/expense-analytics/summary?date_from&date_to&currency (total_spend, transaction_count, avg_transaction, top_category, top_vendor), GET /api/expense-analytics/by-category?date_from&date_to (rows: category_id, category_name, total, count), GET /api/expense-analytics/by-vendor?date_from&date_to (rows: vendor_id, vendor_name, total, count), GET /api/expense-analytics/timeseries?date_from&date_to&interval=day|week|month (rows: period, total, count). Scope by created_by if applicable. Use createDataClient aggregate/query support per existing patterns; if aggregates require custom SQL-like capabilities, implement via the supported Data API query mechanisms and document limitations.

subtasks.title: Add server-side validation for date ranges and interval
subtasks.description: Reject invalid ranges (date_from > date_to) and unsupported interval values with consistent error payloads.

tasks.title: Create Analytics Dashboard page
tasks.description: Create config/pages/expenses/analytics.tsx using json-render with: PageHeader (title 'Expense Analytics'), date range controls (default last 30 days), currency selector (if multi-currency), metric cards bound to /summary, and visualizations bound to /timeseries and /by-category. If chart components exist, render Line/Bar + Pie/Donut; otherwise render tables with sparklines/mini-metrics if available. Include actions: quick presets (This month, Last month, YTD) that refresh_data.

subtasks.title: Add 'Drill down' navigation from analytics rows
subtasks.description: Clicking a category/vendor row navigates to /expenses with filters applied via query params.

tasks.title: Register Analytics route & navigation entry
tasks.description: Update config/apps.json to add route /expenses/analytics → expenses/analytics and add a navigation item under the Expenses group (e.g., 'Analytics').

features.title: Budgets vs actuals
features.description: Add budgeting per period and category with comparisons against actual spend, enabling simple financial planning alongside analytics.

tasks.title: Define Budget schema
tasks.description: Create config/schema/budgets.json with fields: id (uuid, primary key), period_start (date, required), period_end (date, required), category_id (uuid, FK to expense_categories.id, optional for overall budget), amount (decimal, required), currency (text, default 'USD'), notes (text, optional), created_by (uuid, required; FK to users table from audit), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Add indexes on (created_by, period_start) and category_id; add uniqueness constraint on (created_by, period_start, period_end, category_id, currency) to prevent duplicates.

tasks.title: Implement Budgets CRUD API
tasks.description: Create or extend config/api/budgets.routes.ts with: GET /api/budgets (filter by period_start/period_end/currency/category_id), GET /api/budgets/:id, POST /api/budgets, PUT /api/budgets/:id, DELETE /api/budgets/:id. Validate period_start <= period_end and amount > 0; scope by created_by.

tasks.title: Create Budgets List/Create/Edit pages
tasks.description: Create config/pages/budgets/list.tsx and create/edit pages (or modal pattern): DataTable columns period_start, period_end, category, amount, currency; actions add/edit/delete. Forms include period_start/end pickers, category select (optional), amount, currency, notes. Use submit_form and refresh_data patterns.

tasks.title: Add Budget vs Actuals to analytics
tasks.description: Extend analytics API and page: add GET /api/expense-analytics/budget-vs-actual?date_from&date_to&currency returning per-category planned/actual/variance; display as table and (if available) bar chart. Ensure drill-down links to filtered expenses.

subtasks.title: Render variance formatting in UI
subtasks.description: Add conditional formatting (over/under budget) using existing Badge/Color utilities in json-render components.

tasks.title: Register Budgets routes & navigation
tasks.description: Update config/apps.json to add /budgets routes and navigation item (e.g., under Expenses group).

features.title: CSV import/export for expenses
features.description: Enable basic interoperability by exporting filtered expenses and importing CSV statements with mapping to categories/vendors.

tasks.title: Add Expenses CSV export endpoint
tasks.description: Extend expenses API with GET /api/expenses/export.csv supporting the same filters as /api/expenses and returning CSV with columns: expense_date, amount, currency, description, category, vendor, payment_account, reimbursable, status, receipt_url. Ensure user scoping by created_by.

tasks.title: Add Expenses CSV import endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/expenses/import (multipart or JSON text) that parses CSV rows, validates required fields, resolves category/vendor/payment_account by name (create missing vendors optionally behind a flag), and returns a result summary { created, skipped, errors[] }. Provide a dry_run=true mode to preview before committing.

subtasks.title: Define import mapping rules and error reporting structure
subtasks.description: Document accepted headers, date formats, and how unknown categories/vendors are handled; return row-level errors with row number and message.

tasks.title: Create Import/Export UI utilities on Expenses List
tasks.description: Enhance config/pages/expenses/list.tsx with buttons: 'Export CSV' (navigate to export URL with current filters) and 'Import CSV' (navigate to /expenses/import). Create config/pages/expenses/import.tsx with file picker + dry run preview table + confirm import action.

tasks.title: Register Import route
tasks.description: Update config/apps.json to add /expenses/import route and (optional) hide from main nav while keeping accessible from Expenses page actions.

recommendedOrder: Codebase audit & alignment for Expense module
Expense data model + core CRUD APIs
riskAreas: Unknown existing user/auth table naming and how to reliably scope created_by across APIs
Availability of chart/date-range components in the current json-render ComponentRegistry (may require fallback to tables or adding a new component)
Aggregate query support/limitations in the underlying Blazorly Data API client for timeseries and grouped sums
Decimal precision/rounding and multi-currency behavior (analytics should not mix currencies unintentionally)
Timezone boundaries for date filtering (expense_date vs created_at; day/month bucketing consistency)
